reason: Machine lens: all opcodes legal on the 65SC12 (ORA (zp),Y, DEY, BPL, TAX, BEQ, BRA; no Rockwell/WDC extras); applied in a scratch copy, the shipping and -Gameplay builds both assemble (bank 4 ends B392 shipping, B3D9 gameplay, under REN_BASE B400). Entry Y: Z set from sky_row only when sky_rn = 8, and every rn = 8 entry has rt = 7 (bottom row only when L = 7; middle/top rows store 7; the &8000 cross copies rt/rn) and ry a multiple of 8 (ytop = 8*(d2-d1); cross parts -rl-8 and ytop-rc with rl a multiple of 8, ytop >= rc when the cross is taken), so Y = ry+7 = 8k+7. sky_check is only called on the fresh path with d1 = jl >= 1, d2 = jh <= 12, so ytop <= 88 and Y <= 95 < 128: the original's BPL never exits early on a 'negative' start, so the unrolled loop reads the same bytes Y..0 in the same order, leaves A = their OR, Y = &FF; TAX/BEQ/BRA reach the same two targets with the same C result (A, X, Y dead at next_row and dirty). (zp),Y reads are the same reads, so their page-crossing +1s are unchanged. Cycles a whole row of n = 8(k+1) bytes: old 2 + 10n - 1 + 2 + (5 clean | 3 dirty), new 2 + 7n + 3(k+1) - 1 + 2 + (3 clean | 5 dirty): saves 21(k+1)+2 clean, 21(k+1)-2 dirty; at most 254 a row (k = 11), so the claim's 258 is the measurement's rounding (51.7 / 0.2), not a count. Branches in the new listing: BPL A348->A330, BEQ A34B->A360, BRA A34D->A369, BNE A32C->A34F, all inside page A3, so no extra cycles, and the cell loop's branches stay in A3 too. Bytes +21 (the loop goes from 5 to 26 bytes; the tail stays 5). What moves after it in bank 4 (shipping): sprite_column_count A366->A37B (no crossing either way); ck_index A3B2->A3C7, so reads at Y = &39-&4D now take +1 (sprite 3 flipped, sprite 4 kinds in compiled_part); straight_sprite_lo A498->A4AD (no crossing); straight_sprite_hi A4E4->A4F9, so ren_draw_sprite's LDA straight_sprite_hi,X takes +1 for sprites 7-&1B (it did only from &1C); the straight sprites' data moves 21 bytes, which changes which (col_ptr),Y reads cross. These are a few cycles a pass, and the proposer's pcprof figures (-51.7 seed 1, -3.2 RIGHT held) were measured on the bench build, whose bank 4 has the same layout (sky_check A325, ck_index A3B2 in build/strykers-debug_lives.lst), so they already include them. The gate's speed check should confirm the RIGHT-held case (only 3.2 a pass). No self-modified operands or code read as data in sky_check.
